faq-item.faq-q: What is the difference between an OpenAI API developer and a general AI developer?
faq-item.faq-a: An OpenAI API developer specializes specifically in integrating and optimizing OpenAI's API endpoints, including authentication, error handling, cost management, and prompt engineering. A general AI developer may cover model training, computer vision, or MLOps. For a project focused on building a system that reliably uses OpenAI's models via API, a specialist brings deeper, more focused expertise.

faq-item.faq-q: How much does it cost to hire a freelance OpenAI API developer?
faq-item.faq-a: A scoped proof-of-concept typically starts at $1,500 to $4,000. A full production API integration with error handling, caching, and deployment ranges from $8,000 to $30,000 depending on complexity and call frequency. Hourly consulting runs $75 to $150/hr.

faq-item.faq-q: Should I hire one freelance OpenAI API developer or a dedicated team?
faq-item.faq-a: For a single, well-scoped integration project, one experienced freelance developer is typically faster to start and more cost-effective. If your roadmap spans multiple concurrent AI disciplines and needs sustained, embedded team capacity, a dedicated team provider like AtlasML is better matched to that scale.

faq-item.faq-q: How long does it take to build an OpenAI API integration?
faq-item.faq-a: A proof-of-concept typically takes 2 to 4 weeks. A full production integration with error handling, caching, monitoring, and documentation typically takes 4 to 8 weeks depending on endpoint complexity and data volume.
